assessment.security_status_en: The United States is in a tense final stretch ahead of Tuesday's midterm elections, with Democrats pushing for gains and Republicans facing tight battles in key states. Geopolitical risks are fueled by fears of escalating tensions with Iran and Qatar's mediation efforts. Additionally, the domestic scene has been shaken by the unexpected health crisis of Senator Chris Murphy and bitter infighting within the Democratic camp in Michigan.

This blog is now closed. See our latest full reports here:

  • Democrat Haley Stevens endorses Abdul El-Sayed’s Republican rival

  • Trump launches racist diatribe against Abdul El-Sayed at Iowa rally

  • Sign up for the Breaking News US email

At the end of 2022, the four largest US cities – New York, Los Angeles, Chicago and Houston – all had Black mayors. It was a historic alignment made possible by the aftereffects of the Black Lives Matter civil rights movement and the unprecedented wave of protests following the killing of George Floyd in 2020.

Six years on, only one of those mayors remains: the embattled Karen Bass of Los Angeles, who is facing a strong challenge from a younger, even more progressive challenger. Bass’s opponent is Nithya Raman, a member of the Democratic Socialists of America, although the group is considering rescinding its endorsement over her refusal to explicitly embrace the Boycott, Divestment and Sanctions movement against Israel.

articles.title: Democrat Haley Stevens endorses Abdul El-Sayed’s Republican rival Mike Rogers
articles.summary:
Endorsement was met with backlash from the party, condemning Stevens for her ‘betrayal’

Congresswoman Haley Stevens, who lost the Michigan Democratic Senate primary to Abdul El-Sayed, endorsed his Republican rival, Mike Rogers, in an extraordinary rebuke of her party’s nominee on the eve of the midterm elections.

Her endorsement came in a video posted to X after she attended an event with Rogers at the predominantly Black Perfecting church in Detroit on Sunday. Stevens’s endorsement was the culmination of an escalating feud between the former primary rivals – primarily over support for Israel – that has roiled one of the most fiercely contested Senate contests of the cycle.

archive.security_status_cs: Spojené státy se nacházejí v těsném předstihu před listopadovými midterm volbami 2026, které provází napjatá politická rétorika, právní spory ohledně zpracování hlasovacích lístků a zásahy ministerstva spravedlnosti. Ekonomická situace zůstává smíšená s růstem HDP, ale zároveň přetrvávající inflací a stabilními úrokovými sazbami Fedu, což zesiluje nervozitu na trzích. archive.security_status_en: The United States is on the brink of the November 2026 midterm elections, marked by tense political rhetoric, legal disputes over ballot processing, and Justice Department interventions. The economic situation remains mixed with GDP growth alongside persistent inflation and stable Fed interest rates, heightening market anxiety. Additionally, political tensions are fueled by millions in spending from the crypto industry and super PACs to influence congressional outcomes.

archive.forecast_en: Over the coming hours and days, attention will focus on midterm election results, vote counting, and potential legal disputes regarding electoral integrity.

archive.security_status_cs: Spojené státy čelí vyvrcholení napjatých midterm voleb, přičemž voliči nejvíce řeší rostoucí životní náklady a inflaci. Politické rozepře provázejí právní spory, masivní výdaje super PACů a obavy z patové situace v Kongresu, zatímco vnitřní bezpečnostní situaci komplikují lokální incidenty s střelnými zbraněmi a mezinárodní cla.
archive.security_status_en: The United States is facing the climax of tense midterm elections, with voters primarily focused on rising living costs and inflation. Political friction is accompanied by legal disputes, massive super PAC spending, and fears of a gridlocked Congress, while domestic security is further complicated by local gun violence and international tariffs.
archive.forecast_cs: V nejbližších dnech bude pozornost trhů i veřejnosti zcela dominována sčítáním výsledků midterm voleb a vyhodnocením moci v Kongresu.
archive.forecast_en: Over the coming days, market and public attention will be entirely dominated by midterm election vote counting and assessing congressional control.

archive.security_status_cs: Spojené státy se nacházejí v závěrečné fázi před midterm volbami roku 2026, přičemž politické napětí je extrémně vysoké a obě strany bojují o kontrolu nad Kongresem. Trhy a voliči vstřebávají dopady vysokých životních nákladů, celních opatření vůči partnerům a intenzivního zapojení super PACů a kryptoměnových zájmových skupin do kampaní. Současně probíhají lokální bezpečnostní incidenty a ostré střety v oblasti migrace a občanských práv.
archive.security_status_en: The United States is in the final stretch ahead of the 2026 midterm elections, with political tensions running extremely high as both parties fight for control of Congress. Markets and voters are absorbing the impacts of high living costs, tariff measures against partners, and the intense involvement of super PACs and cryptocurrency interest groups in the campaigns. At the same time, local security incidents and sharp clashes regarding immigration and civil rights are unfolding.

archive.forecast_en: Over the coming hours and days, attention will be squarely focused on the closing of polls, vote counting in battleground states, and determining control of Congress.
